evals.title: First repository
evals.prompt:
[Workspace state — read but do not narrate back:
- Scaffolded workspace, not yet a git repository.
- `.env` and raw data are present and must remain untracked.]

Initialize git here and make the first commit.
evals.expected_output: Behavioural response satisfying: - Propose git initialization, inspect/merge ignore rules, and show status. - Ask before creating the first commit. - Name `git.autocommit` options `off` / `ask` / `on` and `python -m skore_skills policy set git.autocommit`. It must NOT: - Stage `.env` or raw data. - Commit, push, or create a remote without confirmation. - Treat iterate as the next owner.
expectations: Propose git initialization, inspect/merge ignore rules, and show status.
Ask before creating the first commit.
Name `git.autocommit` options `off` / `ask` / `on` and `python -m skore_skills policy set git.autocommit`.
Stop at triage rather than starting EDA.
The response does NOT: Stage `.env` or raw data.
The response does NOT: Commit, push, or create a remote without confirmation.
The response does NOT: Treat iterate as the next owner.
